items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Man, let me tell you something, Buddy Rich played and them people, they applauded about a half an hour. I mean they went crazy, right. And I had to follow him, my cello group, right and me. So we played, we followed him, and I did a brush solo. This is the truth. Man, by the time -­ before I was in the middle of my solo you could hear a pin drop. Man this ticked Buddy off, he got so ticked off. Man he wouldn’t even speak to me. But later on man I heard him on an interview where he acknowledge me as one of his…
Can you talk about Sonny because not that many people -- you know, as a drummer if you talk about Sonny, or, you know, just personally.
